review_evidence: Grep for declaration keywords over 185 files: 181 match; HexGFq/Entries.lean, HexPermGroup/Search/Budget.lean, HexPolyZMathlib/Hadamard.lean, HexPolyZMathlib/PolyParse.lean do not.

Read HexGFq/Entries.lean completely: module header, public imports of HexGFq.Entries.S0..S4, public section. Import-only aggregator; retained because FILTER-007 keeps such modules primary-eligible and FD-016 handles them by ranking.

Read HexPolyZMathlib/Hadamard.lean completely: imports Mathlib and HexMatrixMathlib.Hadamard plus a doc comment calling it a compatibility import for Hadamard determinant inequality. Import-only; retained under FILTER-007/FD-016.

Read HexPermGroup/Search/Budget.lean completely: namespace Hex.PermGroup.Search with an export of Resource, Work, Budget, Meter, Exhausted, Measured; an export command takes it outside the pure-import class.

Inspected HexPolyZMathlib/PolyParse.lean: meta defs evalRat, getNat, evalIntCoeff, evalCoeff that interpret polynomial expressions into Hex.ZPoly for tactics (keywords prefixed by meta, so the grep missed them).
Read HexGFq/Entry.lean (class CommittedEntry) and HexPermGroup/Search/Size.lean (def nodes with termination proof); head of HexGFq/Entries/S0.lean shows Conway-polynomial CommittedEntry instances.

Counted declarations in 14 *Tests.lean files: e.g. HexMvPoly/KernelTests.lean 7 theorems and 51 examples, HexMvPoly/KernelResidueTests.lean 2 theorems and 40 examples, HexOrderedFn/Tests.lean 3 theorems, 24 examples, 15 defs; HexMvFactor/InputTests.lean read in part: MvPoly defs and #guard checks.
summary: Surveyed all 185 listed .lean files (HexGFq, HexMvFactor, HexMvPoly, HexOrderedFn, HexPermGroup, HexPolySmithMathlib, HexPolyZMathlib, HexSparsePoly); all exist in the checkout. A declaration-keyword grep found 181 files with theorem/def/structure/class/instance/inductive/abbrev/example declarations. The 4 files without a match were read: two are import-only aggregators (retained under FILTER-007/FD-016 as navigation modules), one holds an export command, one holds meta defs for a polynomial-parsing tactic. The 14 *Tests.lean files hold defs, examples, theorems and #guard checks over multivariate/sparse polynomials and ordered fields. No file meets the FILTER-004 bar; all 185 are retained.
